emptySet: This set has no cards yet. Add cards first.
shownHint: Fields you turn off stay covered until you flip the card.
autoHint: Covered fields are revealed first, then the next card comes. Stops at the last card.
keysHint: ← → move · Space flip · A auto · S sound · F full screen
spotlightHint: Pick one student and show a question. The student answers aloud and you mark it right or wrong.
notSaved: Results aren't saved to the server. They disappear when you close this page.
noClass: You have no class yet. Create one first.
noStudents: No students can join from this class.
participantsHint: Tap students who are away today to leave them out. This list shows names, so close it before projecting.
promptHint: Pronunciation plays the sound without showing the text.
modeScoreHint: One point per right answer. Ends after the set number of questions.
modeSurvivalHint: A wrong answer is out. Ends when one student is left.
noRepeat: Don't pick anyone twice until everyone has been picked
privacyHint: Only numbers are shown by default. With names on, the whole class can see them.
drawFirst: Pick a student to show a question.
question: Question {n}
newRound: Everyone has been picked. Starting a new round.
keysSpot: Enter pick · Space answer · O right · X wrong · F full screen
